v-up.safety: Bend the knees (tuck-up) if full V-ups are too hard.

sit-up.name: Sit-up
sit-up.desc: Lying with the knees bent, roll up until the torso is upright and lower back down.
cues: Knees bent, feet on the floor.
Roll up one vertebra at a time.
Lower slowly back to the floor.
mistakes: Pulling on the head with the hands.
sit-up.safety: Cross the arms on the chest to avoid pulling the neck.

heel-touch.name: Heel touch
heel-touch.desc: Lying with the knees bent and shoulders slightly lifted, reach side to side to touch each heel.
cues: Knees bent, shoulders off the floor.
Reach one hand to the heel on the same side.
Alternate sides with small side bends.
mistakes: Letting the shoulders drop to the floor each rep.
heel-touch.safety: Keep the movement small and controlled.

hollow-rock.name: Hollow rock
hollow-rock.desc: Holding the hollow position and gently rocking back and forth.
cues: Get into a hollow hold, lower back pressed down.
Rock from the upper back to the hips.
Keep the shape the same all the time.
mistakes: The body bending at the hips while rocking.

bear-plank.name: Bear plank
bear-plank.desc: On hands and toes with the knees hovering just above the floor. Hold still.
cues: Hands under the shoulders, knees under the hips.
Lift the knees a few centimetres.
Back flat, breathe calmly.
bear-plank.safety: Set the knees down to rest whenever the back starts to round.

toes-to-bar.name: Toes to bar
toes-to-bar.desc: Hanging from a bar, lift the feet all the way up to touch it.
cues: Hang with straight arms.
Press the bar down and lift the legs.
Touch the bar with the feet, lower under control.
toes-to-bar.safety: Build up with hanging knee and leg raises first.

hanging-oblique-knee-raise.name: Hanging oblique knee raise
hanging-oblique-knee-raise.desc: A hanging knee raise that lifts the knees toward one side, then the other.
cues: Hang or support on the dip station.
Raise the knees up and toward one side.
Lower and alternate sides.
mistakes: Swinging to get the knees up.
hanging-oblique-knee-raise.safety: Keep the shoulders active and the motion slow.

decline-sit-up.name: Decline sit-up
decline-sit-up.desc: A sit-up on a decline bench with the feet hooked. Harder than the floor version.
cues: Feet hooked, lie back on the bench.
Roll up toward the knees.
Lower slowly to the start.
decline-sit-up.safety: Start with a small decline and do not hold the breath.

suitcase-carry.name: Suitcase carry
suitcase-carry.desc: Walking with a weight in one hand only. The trunk works to stay upright.
cues: Weight in one hand, stand tall.
Walk with short, steady steps.
Do not lean toward the weight.
suitcase-carry.safety: Set the weight down with a flat back, bending at the hips and knees.

copenhagen-plank.name: Copenhagen plank
copenhagen-plank.desc: A side plank with the top leg resting on a bench and the bottom leg free. Works the inner thigh and side of the trunk.
cues: Forearm on the floor, top foot or knee on a bench.
Lift the hips into a straight line.
Hold, breathe calmly.
copenhagen-plank.safety: Support at the knee instead of the foot to make it easier.

reverse-plank.name: Reverse plank
reverse-plank.desc: Sitting with the hands behind the hips, lift the hips until the body forms a straight line, face up.
cues: Hands behind the hips, fingers toward the feet.
Lift the hips, legs straight.
Hold a straight line from shoulders to heels.
reverse-plank.safety: Bend the knees (tabletop) if the straight-leg version is too hard.

l-sit.name: L-sit
l-sit.desc: Supporting on straight arms with the legs held straight out in front.
cues: Support on the bars, arms straight, shoulders down.
Lift the legs straight forward.
Hold, keep the legs as high as you can.
mistakes: Bending the knees without meaning to.
l-sit.safety: Start with bent knees (tuck sit) and short holds.

machine-crunch.name: Machine crunch
machine-crunch.desc: A crunch in an ab machine with adjustable resistance.
cues: Set the seat so the pads sit comfortably.
Curl the ribs toward the hips.
Return slowly without letting the stack touch.
machine-crunch.safety: Choose a weight that lets you feel the abs, not the hip flexors.

air-squat.name: Air squat
air-squat.desc: A squat with no added load. The basic pattern for all squats.
cues: Feet about shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
Sit down between the heels, chest up.
Stand up pushing through the whole foot.
air-squat.safety: Squat to a depth you can control. Hold onto something for balance if needed.

jump-squat.name: Jump squat
jump-squat.desc: A squat followed by a jump straight up. Trains leg power.
cues: Squat down to a comfortable depth.
Jump up explosively.
Land softly on the whole foot and sink into the next squat.
jump-squat.safety: Land quietly. Stop the set when the landings get sloppy.

reverse-lunge.name: Reverse lunge
reverse-lunge.desc: Step back into a lunge and return. Often easier on the knees than a forward lunge.
cues: Stand tall, step one leg back.
Lower the back knee toward the floor.
Push through the front foot to return.
reverse-lunge.safety: Hold onto support for balance at first. Add dumbbells when the steps are steady.

lateral-lunge.name: Side lunge
lateral-lunge.desc: Step wide to the side and sit into that hip while the other leg stays straight.
cues: Wide stance, toes forward.
Shift to one side, bending that knee.
Push back to the middle.
mistakes: Heel of the bent leg lifting.
Knee caving past the toes inward.
lateral-lunge.safety: Go only as deep as feels comfortable for the inner thigh.

curtsy-lunge.name: Curtsy lunge
curtsy-lunge.desc: Step one leg back and across behind the other, like a curtsy, then return.
cues: Stand tall, hands at the chest or holding dumbbells.
Step back and across behind the front leg.
Lower, then push back to standing.
curtsy-lunge.safety: Keep the step small at first and hold support if needed.

split-squat.name: Split squat
split-squat.desc: A lunge done in place: feet stay in a staggered stance while you lower and rise.
cues: Long staggered stance, back heel up.
Lower straight down until the back knee nears the floor.
Stand up without moving the feet.
split-squat.safety: Start without weight; hold onto support for balance.

barbell-reverse-lunge.name: Barbell reverse lunge
barbell-reverse-lunge.desc: A reverse lunge with a barbell on the upper back.
cues: Bar on the upper back, stand tall.
Step back and lower the back knee.
Drive through the front foot to return.
mistakes: Short steps that push the knee far forward.
barbell-reverse-lunge.safety: Take the bar from a rack, use collars and start light — balance is the limit here.

step-down.name: Step-down
step-down.desc: Standing on a low step, slowly lower the free heel to the floor and stand back up.
cues: Stand on the step on one leg.
Bend the knee, lower the other heel to the floor.
Lightly touch and stand back up.
step-down.safety: Use a low step and hold a wall or rail for balance.

single-leg-glute-bridge.name: Single-leg glute bridge
single-leg-glute-bridge.desc: A glute bridge with one foot on the floor and the other leg lifted.
cues: On the back, one foot down, other knee up.
Press through the heel, lift the hips.
Hips level at the top, lower slowly.
mistakes: Arching the lower back at the top.

db-hip-thrust.name: Dumbbell hip thrust
db-hip-thrust.desc: A hip thrust with the upper back on a bench and a dumbbell on the hips.
cues: Upper back on the bench, dumbbell on the hips.
Drive the hips up until the body is level.
Pause, lower slowly.
mistakes: Arching the lower back at the top.
Feet too far or too close.
db-hip-thrust.safety: Hold the dumbbell with both hands; a pad under it is more comfortable.

kettlebell-deadlift.name: Kettlebell deadlift
kettlebell-deadlift.desc: A deadlift with one kettlebell between the feet. A simple way to learn the hip hinge.
cues: Kettlebell between the feet.
Push the hips back, back flat, grip the handle.
Stand up tall, lower the same way.
mistakes: Squatting straight down instead of hinging.
kettlebell-deadlift.safety: Keep the bell close to the body. Lower it to the floor between every rep.

nordic-curl.name: Nordic hamstring curl
nordic-curl.desc: Kneeling with the heels held down, lower the body forward as slowly as possible.
cues: Kneel on a pad, heels fixed under something solid.
Body straight from knees to head.
Lower slowly, catch yourself with the hands, push back up.
nordic-curl.safety: Use a padded surface and only lower as far as you can control. Start with very few reps.

donkey-kick.name: Donkey kick
donkey-kick.desc: On hands and knees, push one bent leg up toward the ceiling.
cues: On all fours, back flat.
Keep the knee bent, lift the foot toward the ceiling.
Lower without touching the knee down.
donkey-kick.safety: Lift only as high as the back stays flat.

fire-hydrant.name: Fire hydrant
fire-hydrant.desc: On hands and knees, lift one bent leg out to the side.
cues: On all fours, back flat.
Lift the bent leg out to the side.
Lower slowly.
fire-hydrant.safety: Keep the movement small enough to stay square.

clamshell.name: Clamshell
clamshell.desc: Lying on the side with the knees bent, open the top knee while the feet stay together.
cues: Lie on the side, knees bent, feet together.
Open the top knee like a shell.
Close slowly.
clamshell.safety: Add a band above the knees when it gets easy.

single-leg-calf-raise.name: Single-leg calf raise
single-leg-calf-raise.desc: A calf raise standing on one foot, ideally on a step.
cues: Stand on one foot, ball of the foot on a step.
Lower the heel below the step.
Rise as high as you can, pause.
single-leg-calf-raise.safety: Hold a wall or rail for balance.

tibialis-raise.name: Tibialis raise
tibialis-raise.desc: Leaning the back against a wall, lift the toes up toward the shins.
cues: Back against a wall, feet a step forward.
Lift the toes as high as you can.
Lower slowly.
tibialis-raise.safety: Move the feet closer to the wall to make it easier.

leg-press-calf-raise.name: Leg press calf raise
leg-press-calf-raise.desc: A calf raise pushing the leg press platform with the balls of the feet.
cues: Balls of the feet on the edge of the platform, legs straight.
Lower the heels toward you.
Push the platform away with the toes.
leg-press-calf-raise.safety: Keep the safety catches within reach and use a moderate weight.

cossack-squat.name: Cossack squat
cossack-squat.desc: A deep side squat onto one leg while the other leg stays straight with the toes up.
cues: Very wide stance.
Sit deep over one leg, other leg straight, toes up.
Push back up and switch sides.
mistakes: Heel of the bent leg lifting.
cossack-squat.safety: Hold onto support and go only as deep as is comfortable.

cable-pull-through.name: Cable pull-through
cable-pull-through.desc: Facing away from a low pulley, hinge forward and pull the rope through the legs by driving the hips forward.
cues: Rope between the legs, step away from the pulley.
Hinge back, back flat.
Drive the hips forward to stand tall.
cable-pull-through.safety: Step far enough away that the weight does not lift off the stack at the top.

assisted-pistol-squat.name: Assisted single-leg squat
assisted-pistol-squat.desc: A single-leg squat down to a bench, holding a support for balance.
cues: Stand on one leg in front of a bench, hold a support.
Sit back slowly onto the bench, other leg forward.
Stand up on the same leg.
assisted-pistol-squat.safety: Start with a high bench and lower it over time.

high-knees.name: High knees
high-knees.desc: Running on the spot while bringing the knees up to hip height.
cues: Stand tall, light on the balls of the feet.
Drive the knees up to hip height.
Pump the arms in rhythm.
high-knees.safety: March instead of running to make it quieter and easier.

butt-kicks.name: Butt kicks
butt-kicks.desc: Running on the spot while bringing the heels up toward the glutes.
cues: Light, quick steps.
Bring the heels up behind you.
Knees point down, arms relaxed.
butt-kicks.safety: Start slowly as a warm-up and speed up gradually.

skater-jump.name: Skater jump
skater-jump.desc: Jumping side to side from one leg to the other, like a speed skater.
cues: Stand on one leg, slight bend.
Push off sideways and land on the other leg.
Absorb softly, then jump back.
skater-jump.safety: Start with small steps instead of jumps.

squat-thrust.name: Squat thrust
squat-thrust.desc: From standing, squat, put the hands down, jump or step the feet back to a plank and return. A burpee without the push-up and jump.
cues: Squat and place the hands on the floor.
Jump or step the feet back into a plank.
Bring the feet back in and stand up.
squat-thrust.safety: Step instead of jumping to make it easier.

box-jump.name: Box jump
box-jump.desc: Jumping from the floor onto a sturdy box or low platform.
cues: Stand close to the box.
Swing the arms and jump up.
Land softly with both feet, stand up, step down.
mistakes: Jumping down instead of stepping down.
Landing with the knees caving in.
box-jump.safety: Use a low, stable box that cannot slide. Always step down.

shadow-boxing.name: Shadow boxing
shadow-boxing.desc: Throwing light punches in the air while moving on the feet.
cues: Fighting stance, hands up near the face.
Throw straight punches and hooks, turning from the hips.
Stay light on the feet.
mistakes: Locking the elbows hard at full extension.
shadow-boxing.safety: Do not snap the arms straight. Keep the pace comfortable at first.

stair-climber.name: Stair climber
stair-climber.desc: Climbing on a stair machine at a steady pace.
cues: Stand tall, hands lightly on the rails.
Step with the whole foot.
Choose a pace you can keep for the planned time.
mistakes: Taking tiny steps on the toes.
stair-climber.safety: Start at a slow speed and use the stop button if needed.

elliptical.name: Elliptical
elliptical.desc: Moving on an elliptical machine with smooth, gliding strides.
cues: Feet flat on the pedals.
Push and pull the handles in rhythm.
Keep an even, comfortable pace.
elliptical.safety: Begin with low resistance and increase it gradually.

treadmill-jog.name: Treadmill jog
treadmill-jog.desc: Easy running on a treadmill at a conversational pace.
cues: Clip the safety key on.
Run tall with relaxed shoulders.
Land under the body, short quick steps.
treadmill-jog.safety: Start the belt slowly and stand on the side rails before stepping on.

incline-treadmill-walk.name: Incline treadmill walk
incline-treadmill-walk.desc: Walking on a treadmill set to an incline.
cues: Set a moderate incline and walking speed.
Walk tall without holding the rails.
Keep an even breathing rhythm.
incline-treadmill-walk.safety: Raise the incline gradually; slow down before stopping.

ski-erg.name: Ski erg
ski-erg.desc: Pulling the handles of a ski machine down in a rhythm similar to cross-country skiing.
cues: Handles overhead, slight knee bend.
Pull down with the arms and hinge at the hips.
Return smoothly to the top.
ski-erg.safety: Start with a low damper setting and an easy pace.

bear-crawl.name: Bear crawl
bear-crawl.desc: Crawling forward and back on hands and feet with the knees just off the floor.
cues: Hands under the shoulders, knees hovering.
Move the opposite hand and foot together.
Keep the back flat and the hips low.
bear-crawl.safety: Short distances are enough; rest the wrists between sets.

db-thruster.name: Dumbbell thruster
db-thruster.desc: A front squat with dumbbells at the shoulders flowing straight into an overhead press.
cues: Dumbbells at the shoulders, feet shoulder-width.
Squat down, chest up.
Drive up and press the dumbbells overhead in one motion.
db-thruster.safety: Use light dumbbells; the combination tires you quickly.

kettlebell-clean.name: Kettlebell clean
kettlebell-clean.desc: Bringing a kettlebell from between the legs up to rest at the shoulder in one smooth motion.
cues: Hike the bell back between the legs.
Drive the hips forward.
Keep the elbow close and let the bell roll onto the forearm.
mistakes: Letting the bell flip and bang the wrist.
Curling it up with the arm.
kettlebell-clean.safety: Learn the swing first. Keep the bell close to the body.

double-under.name: Double-under
double-under.desc: A jump rope skill where the rope passes under the feet twice in one jump.
cues: Jump a little higher than usual.
Spin the rope fast from the wrists.
Land softly on the balls of the feet.
double-under.safety: Get comfortable with regular skipping first.

downward-dog.name: Downward dog
downward-dog.desc: A yoga pose with the hips high and the body in an upside-down V.
cues: Hands and feet on the mat, hips lifted.
Push the floor away, long back.
Let the heels sink toward the floor.
mistakes: Rounding the back to force the heels down.
downward-dog.safety: Bend the knees as much as you need to keep the back long.

cobra-stretch.name: Cobra
cobra-stretch.desc: Lying face down, press up through the hands to lift the chest and open the front of the body.
cues: Lie face down, hands under the shoulders.
Gently press the chest up, hips stay down.
Shoulders away from the ears, breathe calmly.
mistakes: Pushing up so high the lower back pinches.
cobra-stretch.safety: Keep the elbows bent if straight arms feel too much for the back.

low-lunge.name: Low lunge
low-lunge.desc: A lunge with the back knee on the floor, sinking the hips forward to stretch the front of the back hip.
cues: Back knee on a mat, front foot flat.
Tuck the pelvis slightly, shift the hips forward.
Raise the arms or keep the hands on the front knee.
low-lunge.safety: Put a folded mat under the back knee.

warrior-ii.name: Warrior II
warrior-ii.desc: A yoga standing pose: a wide stance with the front knee bent and the arms stretched out to the sides.
cues: Wide stance, front foot forward, back foot turned in slightly.
Bend the front knee over the ankle.
Arms out at shoulder height, look over the front hand.
warrior-ii.safety: Shorten the stance if balance or the knee feels off.

tree-pose.name: Tree pose
tree-pose.desc: A yoga balance on one leg with the other foot resting on the inner calf or thigh.
cues: Stand on one foot, gaze at a fixed point.
Place the other sole on the calf or thigh, not on the knee.
Hands at the chest or overhead, breathe calmly.
mistakes: Pressing the foot into the side of the knee.
Hip of the standing leg pushed far out.
tree-pose.safety: Keep the toes of the lifted foot on the floor or hold a wall at first.

pigeon-stretch.name: Pigeon stretch
pigeon-stretch.desc: From hands and knees, bring one knee forward and lay the shin across the mat, the other leg straight back.
cues: Front shin across the mat, back leg long.
Keep the hips square to the front.
Fold forward over the front leg if comfortable.
pigeon-stretch.safety: Put a cushion under the front hip. Use the figure-four stretch on the back if the knee complains.

butterfly-stretch.name: Butterfly stretch
butterfly-stretch.desc: Sitting with the soles of the feet together and the knees falling out to the sides.
cues: Sit tall, soles together, heels toward you.
Let the knees relax down.
Lean forward slightly from the hips.
mistakes: Pressing the knees down with the hands.
butterfly-stretch.safety: Sit on a folded mat if the back rounds.

standing-forward-fold.name: Standing forward fold
standing-forward-fold.desc: From standing, fold forward from the hips and let the upper body hang.
cues: Feet hip-width, knees soft.
Hinge forward, let the head and arms hang.
Breathe slowly, relax the neck.
standing-forward-fold.safety: Bend the knees as much as needed and roll up slowly.

worlds-greatest-stretch.name: Lunge with rotation
worlds-greatest-stretch.desc: A warm-up flow: a long lunge, the inside elbow toward the front foot, then a rotation with the arm reaching up.
cues: Long lunge, back knee down or up.
Bring the inside elbow toward the front instep.
Rotate and reach the same arm to the ceiling.
worlds-greatest-stretch.safety: Move slowly and stay within a comfortable range.

hip-90-90.name: 90/90 hip switch
hip-90-90.desc: Sitting with both knees bent at 90°, rotate the knees from one side to the other.
cues: Sit with both legs bent at 90°, one in front, one to the side.
Sit tall, hands behind for support.
Lift and rotate both knees to the other side.
mistakes: Forcing the knees to the floor.
hip-90-90.safety: Keep the hands down for support and move only within a comfortable range.

hip-circles.name: Hip circles
hip-circles.desc: Standing on one leg and drawing slow, big circles with the other knee.
cues: Hold a wall, stand on one leg.
Lift the knee and draw a large circle out to the side.
Reverse the direction.
hip-circles.safety: Move slowly; this is a warm-up, not a workout.

ankle-circles.name: Ankle circles
ankle-circles.desc: Slowly circling the foot at the ankle in both directions.
cues: Lift one foot or sit with the leg out.
Draw slow, full circles with the toes.
Change direction halfway.
ankle-circles.safety: Hold onto a wall if standing.

cross-body-shoulder-stretch.name: Cross-body shoulder stretch
cross-body-shoulder-stretch.desc: Pulling one straight arm across the chest with the other hand.
cues: Bring one arm across the chest.
Hold it above the elbow with the other hand.
Pull gently, shoulder stays down.
mistakes: Pulling on the elbow joint itself.
cross-body-shoulder-stretch.safety: Pull lightly — you should feel a stretch, not a pinch.

overhead-triceps-stretch.name: Overhead triceps stretch
overhead-triceps-stretch.desc: Reaching one hand down the back between the shoulder blades and gently pressing the elbow with the other hand.
cues: Raise one arm, bend it, hand toward the upper back.
Hold the elbow with the other hand.
Gently guide the elbow back.

inchworm.name: Inchworm
inchworm.desc: From standing, fold forward, walk the hands out to a plank and walk them back.
cues: Fold forward, hands to the floor.
Walk the hands out to a high plank.
Walk the hands back and stand up.
mistakes: Locking the knees hard on the fold.
inchworm.safety: Bend the knees to reach the floor.

thread-the-needle.name: Thread the needle
thread-the-needle.desc: On hands and knees, slide one arm under the body, then open it up toward the ceiling.
cues: On all fours, hips over the knees.
Slide one arm under the chest, shoulder toward the floor.
Rotate open and reach the arm up.
mistakes: Shifting the hips to the side.
thread-the-needle.safety: Move slowly within a comfortable range.

open-book.name: Open book
open-book.desc: Lying on the side with the knees bent, open the top arm across to the other side like turning a page.
cues: Lie on the side, knees bent forward, arms together in front.
Open the top arm over to the other side.
Follow the hand with the eyes, return slowly.
mistakes: Forcing the arm to the floor.
open-book.safety: A pillow under the head keeps the neck comfortable.

wall-slide.name: Wall slide
wall-slide.desc: Standing with the back against a wall, slide the arms up and down the wall in a W-to-Y shape.
cues: Back, head and forearms against the wall.
Slide the arms up as far as you can keep contact.
Lower back to a W.
mistakes: Arching the lower back off the wall.
wall-slide.safety: Stand a little away from the wall if contact is hard to keep.

band-pass-through.name: Band pass-through
band-pass-through.desc: Holding a band wide, move straight arms from the front of the body overhead to behind you and back.
cues: Wide grip on a light band.
Raise the straight arms overhead and back.
Return the same way slowly.
band-pass-through.safety: Widen the grip if the shoulders cannot pass comfortably.

deep-squat-hold.name: Deep squat hold
deep-squat-hold.desc: Sitting relaxed at the bottom of a squat.
cues: Feet a bit wider than shoulder-width, toes out.
Sink as deep as is comfortable, heels down.
Elbows press the knees gently apart.
deep-squat-hold.safety: Hold a doorframe or put a small plate under the heels if they lift.

lying-spinal-twist.name: Lying spinal twist
lying-spinal-twist.desc: Lying on the back, drop the bent knees to one side while the shoulders stay down.
cues: Lie on the back, knees bent, arms out.
Lower both knees to one side.
Keep both shoulders on the floor, breathe.
lying-spinal-twist.safety: Place a cushion under the knees if they do not reach the floor.

kettlebell-halo.name: Kettlebell halo
kettlebell-halo.desc: Holding a light kettlebell by the horns, circle it around the head.
cues: Bell upside down at the chest.
Circle it close around the head.
Change direction after each set or rep.
mistakes: Moving the head instead of the bell.
kettlebell-halo.safety: Use a light weight and keep the bell close to the head without touching it.

wrist-mobility.name: Wrist mobility
wrist-mobility.desc: Circling the wrists and gently rocking over the hands on all fours to prepare the wrists for push-ups and planks.
cues: Circle the wrists slowly both ways.
On all fours, gently rock forward and back.
Turn the fingers to the sides and back, rock again.
mistakes: Putting full weight on the wrists straight away.
wrist-mobility.safety: Keep it gentle; ease off if anything feels sharp.
